## Compliance & storage {.tabset}

### Approval by purpose

Approval rate by scientific vs. educational purpose (Q1).

```{python}
df = h.approval_by_purpose(ddmps)
fig = px.bar(
    df,
    x="Purpose",
    y="Approval rate",
    text=df["Approval rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
    hover_data=["DMPs", "Approved"],
    color="Purpose",
)
fig.update_layout(yaxis_tickformat="0%", showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### ERB decisions

ERB outcome breakdown for this department (Q2).

```{python}
df = h.erb_breakdown(ddmps, derbs)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Decision", y="ERBs", color="Decision", text="ERBs")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### Repository choice

Repository selected for FAIR data publication (Q5).

```{python}
df = h.repository_breakdown(ddmps)
df = df[df["Repository"] != "(none)"]
fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Repository", orientation="h", text="DMPs", color="Repository")
fig.update_layout(yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"}, showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```

### Archive location

Where project data is archived (Q6).

```{python}
df = h.archive_breakdown(ddmps)
fig = px.pie(df, names="Location", values="DMPs", hole=0.4)
fig.update_layout(height=500)
fig
```

### Storage

TU/e-supported vs. external storage (Q3).

```{python}
df = h.storage_split(ddmps)
fig = px.pie(df, names="Category", values="DMPs", hole=0.4)
fig.update_layout(height=500)
fig
```

```{python}
df = h.revision_distribution(ddmps)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Revisions", y="DMPs", text="DMPs", color="DMPs")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False, height=500)
fig
```
